title: Representation Bias in Political Sample Simulations with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the agreement proportion between actual human survey responses and LLM-generated results for samples from English-speaking countries (USA) versus non-English speaking countries (Germany, China).

Evaluating the simulation accuracy (agreement score) of LLM-generated voting behaviors against actual human responses across various demographic categories, including age, gender, income, and education levels.

Measuring the disparity in LLM simulation performance for vote choices and public opinions across different political and electoral systems, specifically comparing democratic/bipartisan regimes with multi-partisan and authoritarian regimes.
